Questions: 
It was consisting of 3 questions having total 1.5 hrs duration. 
 
1. Power Limit  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
( Score-20) 
A and B are 2 resources were given. At each round, we have to select 1 resource  
The power of the resource at the time of selection should be greater than 1. Every 
second, the power of the selected resource gets reduced by 2 and the power of 
unselected resource gets charged by 1. The software stops when at least one 
resource has O power. 
We have to print the maximum number of seconds software can run if you select 
the resources optimally. 
 
Sample input:  
3  5 
 
Sample output: 
6 
 
Explanation: 
At second 1,  select resource B, then powers will be A=4,B=3 
At second 2,  select resource B, then powers will be A=5,B=1 
At second 3,  select resource A, then powers will be A=3,B=2 
At second 4,  select resource A, then powers will be A=1,B=3 
At second 5,  select resource B, then powers will be A=2,B=1 
At second 6,  select resource A, then powers will be A=0,B=2 
 
It was done by simply using a while loop until A or B!=0

4 
 
2. Auto Suggest  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
(Score-50) 
Given a dictionary consisting of N words and a query word & we needed to auto-
suggest the best word from the dictionary that is closest to S using Levenshtein 
distance. If two words have the same Levenshtein distance, then the 
lexicographically smaller word is given priority. 
 
Refer this to understand how to calculate Levenshtein distance 
https://www.scaler.com/topics/levenshtein-distance-python/ 
 
Calculated distance for each word given in dictionary with respect to query word 
and selected the minimum one. 
 
3. Backlink Sorting   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
(Scroe-50) 
You are given N web page titles and corresponding arrays that contain the 
number of backlinks for each web page. The objective is to rank the web pages 
in descending order based on the number of backlinks they have. If having same 
no. of backlinks maintain original order. 
2 arrays where given 1 for titles and 1 for corresponding no of backlinks. 
 
We just had to return titles in decreasing order of no. of backlinks. 
 
Sample input: 
5 
A  B  C  D  E 
110  20  70  50  70 
 
Sample Output: 
A  C  E  D  B

After each round, 6-7 people were eliminated, but there were only 26 people left for 
the HR round, and all 26 were chosen. After the 15-minute HR rounds were completed, 
they announced the results the same day. 
 
Key Insights: 
It was medium level interviews. Everyone’s experience was different based on the 
interviewer they had. Some were quite tough while some were very chill. I feel having 
good knowledge of DSA, OOPS, DBMS, OS and CN was sufficient for this interview. 
They didn’t go into advance concepts like dynamic programming and all.
